question: The Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam(BSA) aims to align Indian evidence law with advancements in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Forensic science and digital technology**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (Indian Evidence Act) aims to modernize evidence laws by incorporating advancements in **forensic science** and **digital technology**.
 
• The amendments address the increasing reliance on **digital evidence**, such as electronic records, emails, social media posts, and CCTV footage, in legal proceedings.
 
• Forensic science advancements, including DNA profiling, fingerprint analysis, and other scientific methods, are being integrated to ensure the reliability and accuracy of evidence.
 
• The Act seeks to align Indian legal practices with global standards by focusing on scientific evidence and digital tools to improve the justice delivery system.
 
• The government aims to combat cybercrime, fraud, and other crimes effectively through the use of advanced forensic and digital technologies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam focuses on modernizing legal evidence practices by adopting scientific and technological advancements.
 
• It aims to strengthen the credibility of legal evidence by integrating forensic science and digital technology into the Indian judicial system.
 
• This modernization is crucial for addressing contemporary challenges like cybercrime, fraud, and the growing reliance on digital data.
